records.title: Dahlia Lounge lunch menu, September 21, 1990
records.descriptionSummary: Eagerly awaited at the time, Tom Douglas' Dahlia Lounge opened on Friday, November 17, 1989. It drew critical acclaim for its innovative cuisine. The Dahlia Lounge replaced the 1904, another restaurant, located at 1904 Fourth Ave. As of September 2012, this restaurant was still in operation.
